name: Slaying Dragons with AI
summary: Formalising a workshop intervention into doctoral research. The hypothesis: a Peterson-style goal-setting programme improves goal attainment not only for university students but for people with far less room to fail — refugees, young people in care and detention, adults in the criminal-justice system.
highlights: Three mediating mechanisms worth isolating: language, the IKEA effect of a self-authored system, and consequences inside criminal-law proceedings
Developed with Franziska-J. Klebôn out of the Tomorrow University Berlin Immersion
Delivered as a live workshop before it was a paper — the failure rate is part of the data
